_hub.eyebrow: The fleet · Monaco and the Riviera
_hub.h1: Two humanoids and a robot dog.
_hub.lead: MONTARI works the crowd. NOVA is the same body with the full SDK, for teams who want to programme it. ORYX is the four-legged one that opens a room and walks a red carpet. Every hire comes with an operator, your logo on the chest and a script written with you.
_hub.title: Humanoid Robot and Robot Dog Hire in Monaco
_hub.desc: Two Unitree humanoids and a robot dog for hire in Monaco and across the French Riviera. Operator included, your branding, a script written with you.

faq.q: Which robot should I hire for an event in Monaco?
faq.a: MONTARI for almost every event. It is the event humanoid: it walks the room, greets guests, poses and delivers your lines. Choose NOVA when you want custom behaviour written for you or a robot your own developers can programme. Choose ORYX, the robot dog, when you want an entrance, a red carpet walk or a four-legged escort through a crowd.

faq.q: How much does it cost to hire a robot for an event in Monaco?
faq.a: The event humanoid and the robot dog start from €2,000 per day with an operator, at the multi-day rate and excluding VAT. NOVA, the developer humanoid, starts from €3,000 per day on the same terms. Single days, custom scripts, travel and staging are quoted separately.

faq.q: Can I hire more than one robot for the same event?
faq.a: Yes. A common pairing is ORYX at the door and MONTARI inside, so guests meet the dog on arrival and the humanoid once they have a glass in hand. Each robot travels with its own operator, so tell us the running order and we price the pair together.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Unitree G1 and the G1 EDU?
faq.a: The body is the same. The EDU version, which we call NOVA, opens the full software development kit, so our engineers or yours can write new motion, voice and integrations rather than run a fixed repertoire. If nobody is going to write code, MONTARI does the same job on the floor for less.

faq.q: How long does each robot perform on one battery?
faq.a: About two hours of active show. Our operator swaps the battery on site between blocks, so an evening is a question of planning the appearances rather than of the robot running out. All three robots need a flat, dry, firm surface of roughly three by three metres to work in.

montari.name: MONTARI
montari.tagline: The showpiece. Walks in, greets your guests and gives every one of them something to film.
montari.teaser: The event humanoid. Works the room, poses for photographs and delivers your lines in English or French.
montari.alt: MONTARI, a Unitree G1 humanoid robot for hire, greeting guests at an event in Monaco
montari.title: MONTARI · Unitree G1 Humanoid Robot Hire
montari.desc: Hire MONTARI, our Unitree G1 humanoid robot, with an operator for events in Monaco and the Riviera. From €2,000 per day, branded and scripted for you.
montari.h1: The guest your room will film.
montari.lead: MONTARI is a Unitree G1 humanoid, built for the floor of an event. It walks among your guests, shakes hands, poses, dances and says the lines you wrote together. Our operator is with it the whole time, so you get the spectacle and none of the risk.

does.h2: What MONTARI does on the night.

items.p: It walks in on cue, ahead of the speech or behind the curtain. The room turns, the phones come up and your evening has a first image.
The robot moves through the room instead of standing in a corner. It waves, shakes hands, tilts its head and reacts to the people in front of it.
Opening words, the brand message, the winner's name. Written with you beforehand and spoken in English, French or both.
It holds a pose, stands still beside a guest and waits for the shot. Every picture leaves the venue with your logo on its chest.
A trophy, a key, a bottle, a small gift. The handover lands better from a robot than from a host with a clipboard.
The wordmark on the chest is a printed decal we replace with your logo, so the robot becomes part of the campaign rather than a rented prop.

fit.h2: When MONTARI is the right robot.
fit.lead: It is the one we send to nine bookings out of ten, because it is built to be seen and to be filmed.
list: Brand activations and product launches where the point is content guests post themselves
Galas and award dinners where the trophy should arrive in a pair of robot hands
Corporate evenings and client parties that need a moment nobody expected
Trade show and yacht show stands that have to pull people off the aisle
Boutique openings on the Golden Square and in the Carré d'Or
Any indoor venue with a flat, dry floor of roughly three by three metres to work in

faq.q: How much does it cost to hire the MONTARI humanoid robot in Monaco?
faq.a: From €2,000 per day with an operator, at the multi-day rate and excluding VAT. A single day, a bespoke script, travel outside Monaco and any staging are quoted on top. Send the date and the venue and you have a firm price within 24 hours.

faq.q: Is a humanoid robot safe around guests?
faq.a: Yes, because it is never left alone. Our operator drives the show, keeps a working distance between the robot and the crowd and stops it instantly if somebody steps too close. It walks at a calm pace, it does not lift heavy loads and it does not move through a room without someone watching it.

faq.q: Can MONTARI speak to our guests in French?
faq.a: It speaks English and French. Most Monaco events use both: a French opening and an English brand message, or lines alternating through the evening. You approve the script before the day, so nothing is improvised in front of your clients.

faq.q: What does MONTARI need from the venue?
faq.a: A flat, dry, firm surface and roughly three by three metres to work in, plus a socket nearby for charging. It does not perform in rain, on loose gravel or on stairs as a routine. We check the floor, the route and the lighting before doors open.

faq.q: How long does the robot perform?
faq.a: About two hours of active show on one battery, swapped on site by our operator. In practice we plan the evening in blocks of fifteen to thirty minutes, which keeps the robot fresh and keeps guests looking forward to the next appearance.

nova.name: NOVA
nova.tagline: The same humanoid with the full SDK, for teams who want to write what it does.
nova.teaser: The developer humanoid. Unitree G1 EDU with the full SDK, for custom behaviour and research.
nova.alt: NOVA, a Unitree G1 EDU humanoid robot for hire, used for custom robot software development
nova.title: NOVA · Unitree G1 EDU Robot Hire with SDK
nova.desc: Hire NOVA, a Unitree G1 EDU humanoid with the full SDK, in Monaco and the Riviera. From €3,000 per day with an operator, for custom behaviour and research.
nova.lead: NOVA is the Unitree G1 EDU: the same body as MONTARI, with the full software development kit open. Our engineers write new behaviour for it, or your team does. It is the robot for demonstrations that have to be exact, for research and for anyone building on ROS 2 and the Unitree SDK.

items.p: Motion sequences, gestures and reactions written for your scenario rather than chosen from a fixed repertoire.
Our engineers work in Python and C++ on top of ROS 2, so the work you pay for is readable, testable and yours to keep.
Cues from the lighting desk, a timecode or a single button backstage. The robot hits its mark when the music does.
Scripted lines or live answers, in English and French, with the timing and the pauses set to the room.
A product database, a booking system, a screen, a lighting rig or an API of yours. The robot stops being a closed box.
Universities and R and D teams hire NOVA to test locomotion, perception and interaction on real hardware without buying it.

fit.h2: When you need NOVA rather than MONTARI.
fit.lead: The body is identical, so choose NOVA only when something has to be written rather than performed.
list: A launch demonstration where the robot must do one precise thing, exactly on cue
A campaign that needs behaviour nobody has seen from this robot before
Research, teaching or a proof of concept that needs real hardware for a few days
Integration with your own product data, API, screen or show control system
A team of your own developers who want the SDK open while they work
A pilot before committing to buying a humanoid of your own

faq.q: How much does it cost to hire the Unitree G1 EDU in Monaco?
faq.a: NOVA starts from €3,000 per day with an operator, at the multi-day rate and excluding VAT. The higher rate covers the EDU hardware and the engineering time around it. Custom development, travel and staging are quoted per project, never charged by surprise.

faq.q: Can our own developers write code for the robot?
faq.a: Yes. That is the point of the EDU version. We hand over access to the SDK, set up the environment with you and stay alongside as the operator. What your team writes during the hire is yours, and we can review it or carry it further afterwards.

faq.q: Which languages and frameworks do you work in?
faq.a: Python and C++ on top of ROS 2 and the Unitree SDK. That covers motion sequences, voice, remote control, sensor work and integrations with your own services. If you already have a stack, we build against it rather than around it.

faq.q: Does NOVA still come with an operator?
faq.a: Always. The robot never performs unattended, including on development days. Our operator handles transport, setup, battery swaps and safety while your team or ours concentrates on the software.

faq.q: Can NOVA also work as an event robot?
faq.a: Yes, it does everything MONTARI does on the floor. Clients book NOVA when the event needs bespoke behaviour on top of the usual repertoire. If the evening only needs a robot that greets, poses and hands over an award, MONTARI is the sensible choice.

oryx.name: ORYX
oryx.tagline: The four-legged one. Opens the door, walks the carpet and carries something small and branded.
oryx.teaser: The robot dog. Entrances, red carpets, photographs and a small branded load through a crowd.
oryx.alt: ORYX, a Unitree Go2 robot dog for hire, walking a red carpet at a Monaco event
oryx.title: ORYX · Robot Dog Hire in Monaco
oryx.desc: Hire ORYX, our Unitree Go2 robot dog, with an operator in Monaco and the French Riviera. From €2,000 per day for entrances, carpets and photographs.
oryx.lead: ORYX is a Unitree Go2, four legs and no hands. It meets guests at the door, trots a red carpet, leads a group to the room and carries a small branded load. It is quick, it is close to the ground and it makes people crouch down with a phone.

items.p: It waits at the door, greets arrivals and sets the tone before anyone reaches the first glass of champagne.
A red carpet run alongside your guest of honour turns the arrival photographs into something the press actually uses.
A branded case, a bottle, an envelope or the award on its back. Light loads only: it is a show, not a porter.
It walks guests from the entrance to the room, down a corridor or between two stands, so nobody needs a sign.
A branded saddle, a decal and your palette on the panels. The dog reads as yours from across the room.
Sitting, shaking a paw, dancing a few bars with the music. Short beats, repeated where the crowd is thickest.

fit.h2: When the dog beats the humanoid.
fit.lead: ORYX works in places a humanoid cannot, and it draws a different, warmer kind of attention.
list: Entrances, arrivals and red carpets where the first image decides the coverage
Tight stands and busy aisles where a fast, low robot moves better than a walking figure
Photo moments with guests who want something to crouch beside
Leading groups between rooms, stands or a terrace during race week
Carrying a small branded item to a stage, a table or a guest of honour
Pairing with MONTARI, the dog at the door and the humanoid inside

faq.q: How much does it cost to hire a robot dog in Monaco?
faq.a: From €2,000 per day with an operator, at the multi-day rate and excluding VAT, the same as the event humanoid. Single days, custom routines, travel and staging are quoted separately. Tell us the date and the venue for a firm price within 24 hours.

faq.q: Is the robot dog safe around guests and children?
faq.a: Yes, with the same rule as the humanoids: an operator is always on the controller and stops it instantly. It moves at a walking pace when it is near people, it keeps a working distance and it never runs loose through a crowd.

faq.q: How much can ORYX carry?
faq.a: A small, light, branded load. A case, a bottle, an envelope or a trophy on a fitted saddle. It does not lift heavy loads and it does not replace a member of your staff. If something matters, a person still carries it and the dog carries the idea.

faq.q: Can it walk outdoors on the Riviera?
faq.a: On a flat, dry, firm surface, yes: a terrace, a pontoon apron, a carpeted entrance. No rain, no loose gravel and no stairs as a routine. We walk the route with you in advance and plan around anything the legs will not like.

faq.q: Can the robot dog speak?
faq.a: It can play scripted speech in English and French through its speaker, which works well for a short greeting at the door. For a conversation with visitors, one of the humanoids with the AI assistant upgrade is the better tool.
